baseline.label: management_projet-baseline-v4-final-schemas
limitations: Synthetic held-out scenarios; no business tools executed.
Knowledge query wording is scored only for nonempty schema-valid text; retrieval factuality is tested separately. Clarifications must match the expected reason and language.
Exact arguments exclude knowledge and clarification. Optional default pagination/period arguments are normalized.
Native Colibri tool buffering means first visible event and wall throughput are not raw decode TTFT/tokens per second.
No hostname, URL, key, private record or operator path is included in the report.
